question: Which country won the FIFA World Cup 2018?
solution:
The correct answer is **__France__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **France won the title by defeating Croatia by 4–2 in the final of the FIFA world cup played on 15 July 2018 at** **Luzhniki Stadium in Moscow. Hence, Option 1 is correct.**
 
• France received the distinction of becoming the **World Cup winner **for the **second time under the captainship of Didier Deschamps**.
 
• Now** Didier Deschamps** is the coach of the team.
 
• France won the FIFA world cup in **1998 also**.
 
• It p**layed the World Cup** final for the **second time in 2006** where Italy had denied them the title, but for the third time, France succeeded in winning the title.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **2018 FIFA Men's World Cup was hosted by Russia.**
 
• FIFA stands for **Federation of International Football Association.**
 
• It is the** highest governing body of Football.**
 
• **It was founded in 1904. **
 
• **Its headquarter **is in** Zurich, Switzerland.**
 
• **The current President of FIFA is Mr. ****Giovanni Vincenzo Infantino (As of Jan 2022).**
 
• **​The 2022 FIFA World Cup will be hosted by Qatar in the last months of the year 2022.**
